question: Who was the author of the famous book 'The Economic History of India'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**RC Dutt**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Economic History of India:-**

 
 
• The book provides a detailed account of India's economic history, starting from ancient times and covering the colonial period until the early 20th century. 
 
• The author of the famous book "The Economic History of India" is RC Dutt.
 
• The book was first published in 1902 and is considered a classic in the field of Indian economic history.
 
 
 
• **RC Dutt:-**
 
 
• He was a prominent Indian economist, writer, and politician who played a significant role in India's struggle for independence from British rule
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dadabhai Naoroji:-**

 
 
• He was a prominent Indian nationalist, social reformer, and politician who is known for his work on Indian economy and his "Drain Theory" that argued that India's wealth was being drained by British colonial policies. 
 
 
 
• **PC Dutta:-**
 
 
• He was an Indian economist and academic who wrote several books on Indian economy and economic policy.
 
 
 
• **RG Bhandarkar:-**
 
 
• He was an Indian historian and scholar who is known for his work on ancient Indian history and culture.
